title: I am convinced there is another world out there. A real world.

classification.question_topic: Invites others to use a journaling technique (writing waking life as dream + dream as waking life) to 'go deeper' and report results; warns it can be scary.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream scene(s) described; only mentions having 'interesting (and creepy)' experiences without phenomenological details (no locations, events, sensory qualities, entities, or spatial relations).

meta.author_theory: Claims there is 'a world beyond' Mall World; suggests lucid dreaming/journaling can access it; withholds what was found to avoid suggestion; says experiences became 'scary' and 'out of hand.'

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology is not describable here beyond general affective descriptors ('creepy', 'scary af') and recurrence/consistency claim; no extractable locations/entities/interactions provided.
